name: Same-game combo: favourite covers AND game goes over
rule: Only when the model's own line disagrees with the market by >= 2.0 on BOTH the side and the total. Priced with the walk-forward empirical joint probability, not the independence assumption.

luck_vs_skill.interpretation: The result sits inside the range that pure chance produces 95% of the time at these prices. It is not evidence of skill.
